ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixels representing scars and water spray against 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels forming the primary fluke body.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid low-intensity black with high-contrast white circular blobs localized at: (0.15, 0.45) left lobe, (0.35, 0.35) left upper margin, (0.45, 0.52) and (0.55, 0.52) adjacent to the central notch, and (0.78, 0.48) right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct detection of at least seven white circular ring-shaped clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, indicating historical barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical linear disruptions (scratches) are visible on the left lobe, cutting across the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular white rosette scars across the ventral surface; significant high-intensity calcified encrustations/accumulations on the distal tips of both lobes.
